# Bhavano

> Bhavano (bhavano.com) is an Indian property and rentals marketplace. It lists homes and spaces to buy, rent or lease — apartments, houses, villas, plots, commercial space, coworking, storage and PG (paying-guest) accommodation — plus furniture. Listings can be browsed without logging in, and every listing is checked before it goes live. Operated by Finfolia Technologies LLP.

Listings are organised by city, then locality, then category. Every listing has its own server-rendered page with price (or "contact for price"), location, photos and attributes.

## URL structure

- City: https://www.bhavano.com/{city} (for example /bengaluru, /chennai, /pune)
- Browse a category in a city: https://www.bhavano.com/{city}/{buy|rent-lease}/{apartment|house|villa|plot|...}, for example https://www.bhavano.com/bengaluru/buy/apartment
- A single listing: https://www.bhavano.com/{city}/{locality}/{rent-lease|buy}/{category}/{listing-slug}
- All cities: https://www.bhavano.com/cities

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.bhavano.com): search and browse all categories
- [Cities](https://www.bhavano.com/cities): every city with listings
- [About](https://www.bhavano.com/about): who runs Bhavano
- [Trust and safety](https://www.bhavano.com/trust): how listings are checked and how to avoid bad ads
- [Help](https://www.bhavano.com/help): FAQs for buyers, renters and owners
- [Moving to a new city](https://www.bhavano.com/moving-to-a-new-city): relocation guide
- [Contact](https://www.bhavano.com/contact)
